'Ghost-hunting Marines' visited an abandoned psychiatric hospital.

In the eighth episode of the YouTube occult content 'Ghost-hunting Marines,' set to air at 9 p.m. on the 9th, Marines alumni Kwak Beom (Class of 1027), Song Jae-hee (Class of 879), and Geuri (Kim Dong-hyun, Class of 1308) are shown visiting an abandoned psychiatric hospital to conduct a search.

The place the 'Marines' visited that day was an abandoned psychiatric hospital known as the ultimate spiritual spot. After confirming the location, Song Jae-hee expressed concern, asking, "Does this feel like the ultimate challenge for 'Ghost-hunting Marines'?" before setting out on the search. Meanwhile, Geuri introduced a newly prepared detector, and even before the full-scale search began, the detectors started shaking and showed unusual reactions.

The three who entered the psychiatric hospital faced iron bars at the entrance and became tense, exclaiming, "This is unbelievable" and "It's really strange." As soon as they stepped inside, a mysterious figure was even captured by a ghost-detecting application, adding an eerie atmosphere from the very start.

Song Jae-hee declared, "I'm going to be strong starting today," displaying the spirit of the Marines, but as the search continued, all three were startled by even small sounds and complained of headaches. Eventually, Song Jae-hee was so startled while inspecting a hospital bed that he stumbled and fell.

The unexpected person who startled them was MZ shaman Cheon Yul-shin-gung Dam-e, who appeared in the fourth episode on the abandoned training center. Dam-e revealed, "The energy here is too strong, so I came early to suppress it," hinting at the unusual atmosphere permeating the psychiatric hospital. She then described various spirits they encountered, stating, for instance, "A male spirit dressed as an 18-year-old private is wandering around." It was even revealed that one of the spirits confessed to a member of the 'Marines,' saying, "You're handsome," leading to an unexpected 'ghost pick.' This raises curiosity about who among the 'Marines' has captured the heart of a ghost.

Along with this, the stories of various spirits residing in the psychiatric hospital are also revealed. During the search, Dam-e said, "An old lady keeps patting me and saying I look like my grandson," adding to the mystery. In addition to drawing the appearance of a spirit she saw directly in a unique illustration, following up on a previous broadcast, she also shared her bizarre first possession experience before receiving a divine spirit.
